reviews.title: If you let it, this app will change your life
reviews.contents:
I received a free subscription to Headspace last year for Christmas, and made it my NY resolution to meditate everyday. And I actually achieved that goal.... 365 straight days, baby! The man who leads the meditations (Andy, I think?) has such a calming, soothing voice that helps bring you in and out of the meditations. Personally, I have a few mental illness diagnoses, and meditating has helped me become more mindful in my everyday life, and therefore I have more awareness of where my mind is. My panic attacks have decreased significantly, and if I slide into a depression, the tools of mindfulness help me to move out of it quickly (**I feel the need to point out that though I know meditation has helped me, it has not cured me. But helped significantly, yes.)
As for the app itself, it has lovely little animations which I love watching, as well as the ability to choose how long you want your session to last. There are everyday, stand alone meditations or 10- 30 day courses. There are mediations that cover topics that range from pregnancy to coping with cravings, sleeping better to waking up early. There is also a tracker that appears at the end of each session to tell you how many days in a row you have mediated, as well as accumulated minutes, which I find helps encourage you to keep going.

I cannot recommend this enough to everyone. Headspace has truly changed my life for the better, and I sincerely hope it does for you too. Good luck!

reviews.title: One of the best apps I have !!
reviews.contents: I strongly recommend reading this review! This app is amazing!! It allows you to do all kinds of courses to help you with meditation! Not only this but it also had relaxing sound to help you sleep which are effective. This app even has a section for physical fitness to help you keep motivated! This outstanding app helps with stress and anxiety and make you feel happy and relaxed! You can subscribe to this app so that you can go online with others for meditation courses and get more options to choose from in the library! However, you do have to pay for the subscription. You may have to pay for some things but most of the things are free and very effective and in my opinion it is worth the money! If you live in a busy city and it is loud at night this app is great as you can put on headphones and block out the cars and people and listen to the soothing sounds of nature, from the beach to the Forrest. This is perfect for people who struggle to sleep well or have stress and anxiety, or even if you want to get motivated to exercise! I recommend this app to everyone and it is definitely worthy of 5 stars! I think this app if perfect for ages 12+ and you should consider downloading it!                                        Hope everyone enjoys this app like me... thanks! 😁

reviews.title: I like it but wish there were a few more free options
reviews.contents:
I really enjoy this app, using the free trial has allowed me to access everything and helped me really begin to understand meditation. I am considering buying a subscription but what puts me off buying it at all is the fact that there aren’t ANY free options on the app at all, except for the app itself. Even if there was just 1 free meditation for each section or 1 free session for each of the individual guides who help you meditate, just so you haven’t got to worry about subscriptions and money when trying to find your own happiness.

 I understand these people are doing us a service which I appreciate as it truly is wonderful and extremely helpful, but it’s really disappointing to see that you can’t even try the first lesson from ‘basics’ without paying for it. It feels a little intimidating to have such a great service locked behind expenses that many people can’t afford to worry about, especially people who are trying to learn to meditate. Clearly they have things to worry about already. 

As for the features of the app itself, they are brilliant. They provide you with nearly everything you might need to find yourself in the mess that is your brain.  Sleepcasts, focus music for different moods, positive thinking reinforcement, ambient noise, stories read aloud, meditation guidance from beginner to expert. It has everything you could ask for, which helps me understand why they ask for money. However, I feel that it is too expensive for meditation.

reviews.title: Good Content, but Poorly Organised
reviews.contents:
At the student price it is wonderful, however I wouldn’t be paying £50 a year for it. The meditations themselves are really quite good, and the sleepcasts are fantastic, but the app needs an overhaul to simplify using it. It is very difficult to find anything at all specific as the search engine is pretty poor and everything is either hidden behind cryptic folders or simply not accessible. I understand the theory of the home or “today” page, but in practice it is another factor making it more difficult to use. The favourited courses are hidden in the top right corner instead of being front and centre, and front and centre is the schedule for today, which I have rarely clicked on. The Wake Up seems to be a brilliant idea, but more often than not it focuses on productivity/work which isn’t what I want to be thinking about whenever I’m trying to clear my head in the morning. The new community comments section is worrying too. I struggle to focus, so it was a nice reprieve to be able to just go on headspace without having to worry what people think. At least you can turn it off.

Until recently I was sure I would continue my subscription, but I have been getting pretty frustrated. If you could at least personalise your “Today” feed to fit your own preferences, the search engine was improved and The Wake Up episodes were archived and easy to find I would definitely consider keeping it.

reviews.title: It’s a no - Privacy??
reviews.contents:
I used this app a few years ago when a lot was free and I found it quite helpful. I stopped using it, I stopped everything in my life due to massive trauma. 
I am desperate for help. Many issues with just a few being extreme stress, anxiety, insomnia, you name it. So I wanted to try this app again to try to find my way back. Not an option.   Everything is now behind an incredibly expensive paywall. Things that are available for free on other apps and platforms such as YT. It is ridiculously expensive simply for a named brand and convenience. 
I always check everything before I download an app, especially the privacy options being the most important. Why do they need to see my purchase history, my contacts… but my search history??? Heck no. People hand over their details so easily to apps like this and then moan that their privacy has been invaded. Yeah, because you handed it over on a plate. 
Sorry but I value my privacy (and money) way too much and will use the apps that offer the same but for free and who don’t want all your private details. As is always the case, people are paying for a brand with this app. Thanks but no.

reviews.title: Work at it, stick with it.
reviews.contents:
You get out what you put in. Headspace has all the tools to help make this a part of you and your life. In the world awash with lifestyle changing apps and quick relaxation apps, headspace is the real deal. Listen, learn, practice and repeat. Meditation is a workout (which is why quick apps don’t work) this app is the training program for the mind and it starts at level zero. The app has a lots of clever tools so check it out before moving on, you will be surprised. Headspace will expand that area in your mind where you can find YOUR headspace and bring control back. 

Working long hours, stress at work, family life with kids, both working parents…. It all became to much and I reached burnout. I took time out, work on CBT and found headspace. I use the app like a tool, to begin I used multiple times a day. Being more competent in meditation and understanding the lessons I now use the app to work on specific areas, for example prioritisation course or areas I am struggling with at the current time. I use the music for focus time at work and when I get sick of meditating on my own I can join the online live sessions. 

Most used app on my phone.

reviews.title: RELATABLE, HELPFUL AND JUST OVERALL AMAZING
reviews.contents: I first found out about this app a couple of years ago. I was indecisive about wether to subscribe. Yesterday I did subscribe and it has helped me in so many ways. Watching some of the animation videos makes me tearful (joy) because of how relatable they are and it projects exactly how I feel and think. It’s nice to listen to a voice who understands truly and has great knowledge about the brain, body feelings and thoughts that people experience day in day out. This app was 1000% worth the purchase for anyone who struggles with mental health and just needs meditation and a voice to listen to. I find that I’m am constantly over thinking at night time and also struggle to sleep. This app offers solutions for both by claiming the mind and taking the ease off of the racing thoughts by practising breathing and mediative techniques. This app offers 24 hour support videos and voice recordings in which you can access at any time leaving you feeling not alone with your thoughts and it’s like having a easily accessible therapist who makes you feel better about everything at any given time, any given place and anywhere in the world.

reviews.title: Best app ever!
reviews.contents: This app is good for people who generally can’t sleep or focus with anything. Or some things. And, have you ever noticed your lying in bed you have your phone your eyes start closing you try to sleep and all of a sudden your wide awake! Well this app is perfect for anyone really. Also good for people with asthma and people who suffer with lung disease or cancer, and people who can’t breath as good in general. So if your having problems, breathing, sleeping, depression, well you might as well download the app even if you don’t have any problem at all! I downloaded this app because I’ve been trying to sleep but then I can’t... it’s so annoying that at that moment your so exited but from that excitement yeah, pretty much you can’t sleep for about 7 hours and it’s annoying I mean seriously your trying to rest for 7 hours when for some people, only 10 minutes! So yeah I recommend the app by the way it’s just my favourite app so far in 2020 hope to see new meditation skits and stuff! So yeah just, decide your self you don’t  have to take my word look at everyone else or even decide yourself... ok that’s it from me now, bye!

reviews.title: Gratitude
reviews.contents: Myself and my colleagues were offered the Headspace app, as an experiment from my employer. I wouldn’t usually have volunteered , as I was way out of my comfort zone! Something about Headspace drew me in though and despite my fears and anxiety I signed up. It’s positively changed my life. It’s been over a year now, and I try to maintain it every day. I still have fears and anxieties, but overall I am at peace. I have learned forgiveness to myself, and those around me. I am finding that I am more willing to try things without the pressure of being perfect.  I try because I’m curious rather than the outcome.  I am enjoying spending quality time on myself, and see it as an investment. The blue sky is my favourite lesson of all, together with the reminders that change is constant. I am so grateful for the opportunity to try Headspace. My family and friends are also thankful for the benefits they see. It has inspired some of them to use Headspace too. Thank you to all of the Headspace team from the bottom of my heart. You have brought love and acceptance to so many of us. xxx

reviews.title: Please stop tinkering with Headspace
reviews.contents: I have been a Headspace user for 10 years and it is what helped me form a daily meditation practice. I have noticed in recent months there has been a LOT of tinkering with the app as noted by the number of updates (almost now a weekly thing). I am pleased that you have decided to revert one of these dreadful changes and that the daily vertical timeline is back - it is excellent compared to the awful horizontal one with no check marks to enable you to see if you have done any of the sections. However as mentioned by another recent review the daily meditation now auto defaults every day back to Andy 3 mins which is very frustrating when just about to start meditation - it used to save your preferred teacher and time. A further change for the worse is that the activity history is always incorrect and this used to be useful to see what you had done when. The changes seem without any sense or thought and having seen other reviews I am not alone in feeling this frustration which no doubt will cause users to change to one of the many other ( sometimes free apps eg Insight Timer) . Please take your regular and loyal users views into consideration 🙏🏻
